name: locust
description_en: Write scalable load tests in plain Python 🚗💨
readme_excerpt: Locust Locust is an open source performance/load testing tool for HTTP and other protocols. Its developer-friendly approach lets you define your tests in regular Python code. Locust tests can be run from command line or using its web-based UI. Throughput, response times and errors can be viewed in real time and/or exported for later analysis.
